authorization.budget_rule: do not spend on name-only repeats

mode: AB-H / AB-R case adjudication; AB-P gates unchanged
pre_exposure: Before preregistration, public search disclosed Maroto XIV/XV fiche with same id1; September 2026 Senate high/low changes, CCyL parliamentary appointment notice, and names of three appointees. This is not blinded sampling nor a preregistered confirmation of an unobserved hypothesis.
question: For a small fixed identity and tenure sample, can linked official senator fichas plus an independently publishing autonomous parliament certify same-person appointments and reject false identity joins caused by replacement or surname collision?

positive_pairs.expected: same person, distinct term/credential and 2026 10/09 cessation 11/09 appointment

positive_pairs.expected: same appointment case if date appointing organ and full name align

positive_pairs.expected: same appointment case if date appointing organ and full name align

negative_pairs.right: Carmen María Díaz Ruiz, replacement Aug 2026
negative_pairs.expected: different people despite succession into same institutional slot

negative_pairs.left: Juan Pablo Martín Martín, XV senator

acceptance.positive: linked person record with full-name match, appointing authority and dated action in CCyL+Senate OR explicit provider-maintained past-legislature navigation for P1; status REVIEW if independent evidence not directly available
acceptance.negative: explicit substitution statement, or separate provider IDs and full given-name disambiguation; status REVIEW if no direct profiles
acceptance.time: record act_event_date, Senate_effective_at/start/end, and document_publication_date independently; keep first_public_at=NULL unless independent publication timestamp archive verifies it.
acceptance.error_controls: name-only no acceptance; same seat replacement must be negative; surname-only must be negative; reconcile apparent 2026 reappointment break and previous tenure; no group or person inference solely from votes
acceptance.sample_limit: 5 pairs, no expansion after results unless separately authorized new cycle; do not attribute population error-rate to sample

falsification: If profiles do not explicitly crosslink same id or appointing organization/dates conflict, mark unresolved; if Senate replacement unclear, negative unresolved.
use: exploratory hand-adjudicated gold MICRO sample for identity joins only, not scores/backtest/release
